statement:
Let \(a\) be a non-negative real number and the sequence \((u_n)\) defined by \(u_1 = 6\) and \(u_{n+1} = \dfrac{2n+a}{n} + \sqrt{\dfrac{n+a}{n}}\, u_n + 4\) for all \(n \geq 1\).\\
a) For \(a = 0\), prove that \((u_n)\) has a finite limit and find that limit.\\
b) For \(a \geq 0\), prove that \((u_n)\) has a finite limit.

Find all functions \(f : \mathbb{R}^+ \to \mathbb{R}^+\) such that
\[f\!\left(\frac{f(x)}{x} + y\right) = 1 + f(y)\]
for all \(x, y \in \mathbb{R}^+\).

Let \(ABC\) be a triangle. Points \(E, F\) move on the opposite rays of \(BA, CA\) respectively such that \(BF = CE\). Let \(M, N\) be the midpoints of \(BE, CF\). Line \(BF\) meets \(CE\) at \(D\).\\
a) Let \(I\) be the circumcenter of \(\triangle DBE\) and \(J\) the circumcenter of \(\triangle DCF\). Prove that \(MN \parallel IJ\).\\
b) Let \(K\) be the midpoint of \(MN\) and \(H\) the orthocenter of \(\triangle AEF\). Prove that as \(E\) varies on the opposite ray of \(BA\), the line \(HK\) passes through a fixed point.

For every pair of positive integers \((n, m)\) with \(n < m\), let \(s(n, m)\) denote the number of positive integers in \([n, m]\) that are coprime with \(m\). Find all positive integers \(m \geq 2\) satisfying:\\
i) \(\dfrac{s(n,m)}{m-n} \geq \dfrac{s(1,m)}{m}\) for all \(n = 1, 2, \ldots, m-1\);\\
ii) \(2022m + 1\) is divisible by \(m^2\).

Consider two non-constant polynomials \(P(x), Q(x)\) with nonnegative coefficients. The coefficients of \(P(x)\) are all at most \(2021\) and \(Q(x)\) has at least one coefficient greater than \(2021\). Assume \(P(2022) = Q(2022)\) and both share a root \(\tfrac{p}{q} \neq 0\) (\(p, q \in \mathbb{Z}\), \(\gcd(p,q)=1\)). Prove that \(|p| + n|q| \leq Q(n) - P(n)\) for all \(n = 1, 2, \ldots, 2021\).

We are given 4 identical dice. Let \(x_i\) (\(1 \leq x_i \leq 6\)) be the number showing on the \(i\)-th die, \(1 \leq i \leq 4\).\\
a) Find the number of outcomes \((x_1, x_2, x_3, x_4)\).\\
b) Find the probability that some \(x_j\) equals the sum of the other three.\\
c) Find the probability that \(x_1, x_2, x_3, x_4\) can be split into two groups with equal sums.

Let \(ABC\) be an acute triangle with \(B, C\) fixed and \(A\) moving on the major arc \(BC\) of \((ABC)\). Let \(O\) be the circumcenter (with \(B, O, C\) non-collinear, \(AB \neq AC\)) and \((I)\) the incircle tangent to \(BC\) at \(D\). Let \(I_a\) be the \(A\)-excenter. Line \(I_aD\) meets \(OI\) at \(L\). Let \(E\) lie on \((I)\) such that \(DE \parallel AI\).\\
a) Line \(LE\) meets \(AI\) at \(F\). Prove that \(AF = AI\).\\
b) Let \(M\) lie on the circle \((J)\) through \(I_a, B, C\) such that \(I_aM \parallel AD\). Line \(MD\) meets \((J)\) again at \(N\). Prove that the midpoint \(T\) of \(MN\) lies on a fixed circle.
